note: Curated shortcuts, not a whitelist. Any Ollama tag can be installed by typing it. Capability hints are for display before install; the real answer comes from /api/show afterwards. size_gb is GiB of weights.

tiers.label: Under 6 GB
tiers.note: One small model doing both jobs. Expect short tasks rather than long agentic runs.

tiers.label: 20 to 32 GB
tiers.note: What Aether was built and tuned on.

tiers.label: 32 to 64 GB
tiers.note: The tuned pair with room for a much longer context window.

tiers.label: 64 GB and up
tiers.note: A 70B for chat, with the vision model kept for computer use.

qwen3.8:27b.label: Qwen3.8 27B
qwen3.8:27b.description: Aether's default. Sees images, thinks, and calls tools, so it covers chat, agentic work and computer use on its own.

qwen3-coder:30b.label: Qwen3-Coder 30B
qwen3-coder:30b.description: Mixture of experts, so it emits tool calls much faster than a dense model its size. No vision.

qwen3:4b.label: Qwen3 4B
qwen3:4b.description: Smallest model that still calls tools reliably. The floor for agentic work.

qwen3:8b.label: Qwen3 8B
qwen3:8b.description: General chat and light agentic work on a mid-range card.

qwen3:14b.label: Qwen3 14B
qwen3:14b.description: Noticeably stronger reasoning than 8B, still comfortable on 16 GB.

qwen3:32b.label: Qwen3 32B
qwen3:32b.description: Dense 32B for chat and reasoning when there is memory to spare.

qwen3:30b-a3b.label: Qwen3 30B A3B
qwen3:30b-a3b.description: Mixture of experts general model. Fast for its size, thinks and calls tools.

qwen2.5-coder:7b.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B
qwen2.5-coder:7b.description: Small coding agent. Fits alongside a chat model on 12 GB.

qwen2.5-coder:14b.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 14B
qwen2.5-coder:14b.description: Mid-size coding agent, a clear step up from 7B on multi-file work.

qwen2.5-coder:32b.label: Qwen2.5-Coder 32B
qwen2.5-coder:32b.description: Dense coding model. Slower per step than the 30B MoE but strong on hard edits.

devstral:24b.label: Devstral 24B
devstral:24b.description: Built specifically for agentic coding and tool use in a codebase.

gemma3:4b.label: Gemma 3 4B
gemma3:4b.description: Small model that can see images. No tool calling, so chat only.

gemma3:12b.label: Gemma 3 12B
gemma3:12b.description: Strong multimodal chat. No tool calling, so chat only.

gemma3:27b.label: Gemma 3 27B
gemma3:27b.description: Largest Gemma 3. Excellent multimodal chat, but it cannot call tools.

mistral-small3.2:24b.label: Mistral Small 3.2 24B
mistral-small3.2:24b.description: Multimodal and calls tools, so it can cover chat, agentic and computer use.

llama3.2:3b.label: Llama 3.2 3B
llama3.2:3b.description: Very small and quick. Tool calling is unreliable at this size.

llama3.1:8b.label: Llama 3.1 8B
llama3.1:8b.description: Well-rounded general chat model with tool calling.

llama3.3:70b.label: Llama 3.3 70B
llama3.3:70b.description: Frontier-class chat quality locally. Needs roughly 48 GB before it is comfortable.

deepseek-r1:14b.label: DeepSeek-R1 14B
deepseek-r1:14b.description: Reasoning specialist. Thinks at length, so give it a generous context window.

phi4:14b.label: Phi-4 14B
phi4:14b.description: Compact and strong at maths and structured reasoning.

granite3.3:8b.label: Granite 3.3 8B
granite3.3:8b.description: IBM's small instruct model. Apache licensed, solid tool calling.

qwen2.5:0.5b.label: Qwen2.5 0.5B
qwen2.5:0.5b.description: Names chats on the CPU so the main model is never interrupted.
